bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
root="$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
stage="$root/.worktrees/shared-menu-a1b687d-20261115"
test "$(git -C "$stage" rev-parse HEAD)" = a1b687d2982b05f6358974bc428a63a909f98ed1 || exit 60
container="$(docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -E '(^|[-_])gaybbs([-_]|$)' | head -n1)"
test -n "$container" || exit 61
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' "$container")" = true || exit 62
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' "$container")" = "$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:shared-a1b687d)" || exit 63
docker logs --since 10m "$container" 2>&1 | grep -q 'GAYBBS_BOT_READY' || exit 64
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 65
test "$(systemctl --user is-enabled gace-userbot-verify.service)" = enabled || exit 66
cd "$root"
PYTHONPATH=scripts timeout 75s python3 scripts/userbot_test_client.py bot_start_menu | grep -q '^USERBOT_TEST_MENU_ROWS=3,2,2,3,1$' || exit 67
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 68
project="$(docker inspect -f '{{index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.project"}}' "$container")"
counts="$(docker compose -p "$project" --project-directory "$root/deploy" -f "$stage/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml" exec -T postgres psql -U gace -d gaybbs -t -A -c "SELECT count(DISTINCT chat_id) FROM board_menu_panels WHERE panel_type='posting' AND state='published' AND chat_id=ANY(ARRAY[-1003847210571,-1002373696859,-1003770334893]::bigint[])" 2>/dev/null | grep -E '^[0-9]+$' | head -n1)"
echo LIVE_SHARED_SOURCE_SHA=a1b687d2982b05f6358974bc428a63a909f98ed1
echo LIVE_BOT_READY=PASS
echo LIVE_DM_11_BUTTONS=PASS
echo USERBOT_SERVICE_ACTIVE=PASS
echo PUBLISHED_BOARD_PANEL_COUNT="$counts"
